list_skills: list all available skills from both public and custom directories via GET /api/skills
install_skill: install a skill from a .skill file located in a thread's user-data directory via POST /api/skills/install
edit_custom_skill: edit the content of a custom skill by updating its SKILL.md file via PUT /api/skills/custom/{skill_name}
rollback_custom_skill: rollback a custom skill to a previous version using its edit history via POST /api/skills/custom/{skill_name}/rollback
update_skill_enabled: enable or disable a skill by updating its status in extensions_config.json via PUT /api/skills/{skill_name}
